name: Barry Finegold
committees: Joint Committee on Economic Development and Emerging Technologies (Senate chair)
stance: Sponsor of the Massachusetts Transparency in Frontier AI Act with independent audits; prefers a federal standard but says states must act if Congress will not.

statements.text: The Senate passed his economic development bill including frontier-AI provisions requiring catastrophic-risk frameworks, independent third-party safety audits every four months and Attorney General enforcement.

I understand that there's some concerns out there, and we can work through those concerns. But to not have audits and third-party verifications of making sure that things are being done the way they should be, I think is a mistake.
